prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium shot. An old woman seen from behind, her face not visible, a shawl over her head, stands in the open doorway of the ark looking out over the valley and the tents below. Grey morning, wind in her shawl. Sorrowful and resolute. The ark is one long, low, box-shaped wooden hull with straight sides of rough planks and flat square ends, the same low height from end to end. The ark has no mast, sail, prow, figurehead, funnel or smokestack, no smoke rising from it and no band along its waterline. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the great wooden ark, the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
